title: Table 71. UFQFPN32 - Mechanical data
text_helper: Table 71. UFQFPN32 - Mechanical data — section 1.2 REF. Symbol, Millimeters / Min, Millimeters / Typ, Millimeters / Max, Inches(8) / Min, +2 autres.

notes: 2. UFQFPN stands for ultra-thin fine pitch quad flat package no lead: A ≤ 0.60 mm / Fine pitch e ≤ 1.00 mm.
3. The profile height, A, is the distance from the seating plane to the highest point on the package. It is measured perpendicular to the seating plane.
4. A1 is the vertical distance from the bottom surface of the plastic body to the nearest metallized package feature.
6. Dimension b applies to metallized terminal. If the terminal has the optional radius on the other end of the terminal, the dimension b should not be measured in that radius
7. BSC stands for BASIC dimensions. It corresponds to the nominal value and has no tolerance.
8. Values in inches are converted from millimeters and rounded to four decimal digits.
12. N represents the total number of terminals.
15. Dimension b and L are measured at the terminal planting surface. 106/124 DS14720 Rev 3
